name: Pendulum Quadruped Hip Extension
description: A glute isolation exercise performed on all fours, extending one leg backward and upward with the knee bent at 90 degrees. This movement isolates the gluteus maximus through hip extension while minimizing hamstring involvement due to the bent-knee position.

execution.starting_position: Begin on all fours with hands under shoulders and knees under hips. Working leg has the knee bent at 90 degrees.
execution.setup_instructions: No equipment needed. Position on a padded floor or mat.
steps: Step 1: Keeping the knee bent at 90 degrees, drive the working heel toward the ceiling.
Step 2: Extend the hip fully at the top — sole of the foot faces the ceiling.
Step 3: Squeeze the glute maximally at the top position.
Step 4: Return the knee toward the floor in a controlled manner.
execution.breathing_instructions: Exhale as the leg lifts. Inhale on the return.
common_mistakes: Hyperextending the lower back to gain range instead of using glute strength
Rotating the hip to the side rather than extending straight back
safety_considerations: Keep the lower back neutral — do not let it arch aggressively
execution.range_of_motion_guidance: Full hip extension at the top with the thigh in line with or slightly above parallel to the floor.
coaching_cues: Drive the heel to the ceiling
Squeeze the glute at the top
